Standalone bundled-runtime release.

### Highlights

- One Windows package bundles OptiX 8.1, 9.0, 9.1, and OIDN 2.4.1.
- Houdini discovery and SideFX `idenoise` / `hoiiotool` integration have been
  removed.
- Choose OptiX or OIDN in the GUI or with `--backend optix|oidn`.
- Use `--optix-version` to select the OptiX runtime; 9.0 is the default.
- Runtime env overrides were removed; use the bundled package and explicit
  options instead.

### Assets

- `h-denoise-bundled-windows-x64-v2.0.0.zip`
- `oidn-denoiser-windows-x64-oidn-2.4.1-*.zip`
